description: Ammonia and ammonia-related-products manufacturer, formed in 1968 and headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, with production at El Dorado, Arkansas, Cherokee, Alabama and Pryor, Oklahoma, and a facility operated for Covestro in Baytown, Texas.
